overview: Implement a dedicated terminal daemon (terminald) with a WebSocket-first protocol, plus a tmux-like CLI (vibe-ctl) and a desktop agent proxy that preserves existing desktop/mobile payload compatibility. Sessions must survive desktop agent restarts and follow the protocol and limits defined in docs/terminal_daemon_plan.md.
goals: Terminal sessions survive desktop agent restarts by moving PTY ownership to terminald
Provide a WebSocket protocol that matches the specified envelope, actions, events, and compatibility payload
Deliver a tmux-like CLI (vibe-ctl) for listing, attaching, sending input, resizing, renaming, and stopping sessions
Maintain existing payload schema compatibility for desktop/mobile UIs
Cross-platform support for macOS, Windows, and Linux
nonGoals: UI redesigns beyond optional warning/status surfaces
Multi-user access control beyond single token auth
successMetrics: Sessions remain active after desktop agent restart (verified by attach and output continuity)
Existing desktop/mobile terminal views render output correctly without schema changes
Median stream update latency < 100ms and p95 < 250ms under moderate load
Sustains 5 MB/s aggregated output with deterministic truncation recovery
No unbounded memory growth over 24h with idle sessions at max limits

stack.framework: Rust (desktop crate with new terminald and vibe-ctl binaries)
stack.hosting: Local daemon on localhost WebSocket (optional UDS where supported)
stack.auth: Token-based auth via discovery file with localhost-only binding

routes.name: Discovery file
routes.purpose: Endpoint/token discovery for CLI and agent

uiNotes: Keep existing terminal payload schema unchanged for desktop/mobile
If warnings are surfaced in UI, follow the plan’s banner/toast/status-pill guidance and a11y notes
Do not block input when showing session warnings or stream pause indicators

importFormat.description: Not applicable. Clients discover endpoint/token via discovery file or VIBE_CTL_* env overrides.

rules: Auth request must be received within 3 seconds; otherwise return auth error and close
Protocol uses semantic versioning; major mismatch must fail
Session-scoped actions require session_id in the envelope
Output seq is strictly monotonic per session; truncation must include snapshot
If payload exceeds limits, emit session_warning and follow truncation/close rules
Backpressure triggers stream_paused, then snapshot, then stream_resumed or disconnect
Unknown fields in requests/events must be ignored for forward compatibility

stories.title: Scaffold terminald + vibe-ctl binaries and shared terminal_core module
stories.description: As a developer, I want dedicated binaries and a shared module so daemon/CLI/agent can reuse terminal logic without duplicating code.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `desktop/src/bin/terminald.rs` and `desktop/src/bin/vibe-ctl.rs` with minimal main functions and argument parsing hooks
Add `desktop/src/terminal_core.rs` and export it from the desktop crate without changing existing desktop runtime behavior
Install CLI deps: `cargo add clap --features derive`, `cargo add tokio-tungstenite`, `cargo add crossterm`
Example: `cargo run --bin vibe-ctl -- --help` prints usage and exits 0
Negative: `cargo run --bin vibe-ctl -- unknown` exits non-zero and prints a helpful error

stories.title: Extract terminal session core into terminal_core
stories.description: As a developer, I want session lifecycle, buffering, and payload building centralized so both terminald and the desktop agent use identical logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Move PTY lifecycle, buffer management, vt100 parsing, and payload building from `desktop/src/terminal.rs` into `terminal_core`
Desktop agent code uses terminal_core functions and preserves payload schema compatibility
Example: existing desktop terminal start/poll responses match the current payload fields and values
Negative: missing session_id in a session-scoped call returns `missing_session` error

stories.title: Discovery file creation and config overrides
stories.description: As a client, I want a discovery file to locate terminald and authenticate without manual configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: terminald writes a discovery file at OS config dir with fields ws_url, token, version, pid, created_at, capabilities
Discovery file write is atomic and file permissions are user-only
CLI honors overrides: `VIBE_CTL_ENDPOINT`, `VIBE_CTL_TOKEN`, `VIBE_CTL_CONFIG`
Example: setting `VIBE_CTL_CONFIG` to a temp file allows vibe-ctl to connect using that endpoint
Negative: unreadable config path returns `connection_failed` without crashing

stories.title: terminald WebSocket server + auth handshake
stories.description: As a client, I want a stable WebSocket server that authenticates and advertises server capabilities before I send commands.
acceptanceCriteria: terminald listens on localhost (default ws://127.0.0.1:7078/ws) and rejects non-localhost connections
Server requires `auth` within 3 seconds and responds with server_info (version, server_time, capabilities)
Major protocol version mismatch returns an error and closes the socket
Example: valid token yields `ok: true` auth response with server_info
Negative: missing or invalid token yields `invalid_auth` and connection close

stories.title: Implement list/start/stop/rename/resize/keepalive actions
stories.description: As a client, I want core session management actions so I can create and manage terminal sessions via terminald.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement `list`, `start`, `stop`, `rename`, `resize`, and `keepalive` actions per the protocol
`start` returns session_id and initial terminal_payload; `list` returns session summaries
`rename` and `resize` are idempotent when unchanged
Example: `start` with label "" and default size returns a running session with auto-generated label
Negative: `resize` with cols < 10 or rows < 4 returns `invalid_size`

stories.title: Attach/poll/input streaming + compatibility payloads
stories.description: As a client, I want attach/poll/input so I can stream output and send input while keeping payload compatibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement `attach`, `detach`, `poll`, and `input` actions with the specified envelope
Attach adds a subscription and immediately emits a terminal_payload event with output since `since`
`poll` returns terminal_payload with output since `since` and notifications since `notify_since`
Example: `input` of "ls -la\n" results in output chunks with incremented seq
Negative: providing both `data` and `data_b64` yields `invalid_request`

stories.title: Sequencing, truncation, snapshot, and session_warning
stories.description: As a client, I need deterministic sequencing and truncation recovery so output remains consistent under high volume.
acceptanceCriteria: Output seq is strictly monotonic per session; next_seq equals last delivered + 1
When buffer is truncated, responses/events set `truncated: true` and include `snapshot`
Emit `session_warning` with reason `buffer_truncated` when truncation occurs
Example: writing > 512 KB to a session yields `truncated: true` with a snapshot on next poll
Negative: if snapshot alone exceeds max payload, emit `payload_too_large` warning and close connection

stories.title: Backpressure handling + stream pause/resume + subscription limits
stories.description: As a server, I need bounded queues and backpressure so slow consumers do not cause memory growth.
acceptanceCriteria: Per-connection send queue is bounded by bytes; exceeding triggers `stream_paused`
On backpressure, drop intermediate payloads and send a snapshot with `truncated: true`
Emit `stream_resumed` when queue falls below low-water mark
Example: a slow client triggers `stream_paused` and later receives a snapshot before resuming
Negative: attaching more than 4 sessions on one socket returns `state_locked`

stories.title: Session summary persistence and idle cleanup
stories.description: As a client, I want session summaries persisted so I can list sessions after daemon restart.
acceptanceCriteria: Persist session summaries to JSON with atomic write (tmp + fsync + rename)
On startup, load summaries and mark stale entries as exited
Idle sessions are cleaned after the configured TTL, with warning lead time
Example: restart terminald and `list` shows previous sessions with status exited
Negative: corrupted summaries file is ignored with a warning and does not crash

stories.title: Desktop agent proxy to terminald
stories.description: As a mobile/desktop client, I want the desktop agent to proxy terminald while keeping existing payload schemas intact.
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop agent no longer owns PTY; it uses a terminald WS client for start/poll/input/resize/rename/stop
Proxy preserves existing payload shape for mobile/desktop UI compatibility
Agent can auto-start terminald when unreachable (configurable)
Example: start a session via mobile, restart desktop agent, and attach continues with same session_id
Negative: if terminald is unreachable, agent returns `connection_failed`

stories.title: vibe-ctl CLI core commands
stories.description: As a user, I want a tmux-like CLI to list and manage sessions without attaching.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement commands: `ls`, `new`, `send`, `resize`, `rename`, `stop` with documented flags
Global overrides: `--endpoint`, `--token`, `--config`, and `--json` for `ls`
`new` supports name/cwd/cols/rows/env; `send` supports `--file`
Example: `vibe-ctl ls --json` prints machine-readable JSON and exits 0
Negative: `vibe-ctl new --cols 5` returns `invalid_size` and exits non-zero

stories.title: vibe-ctl attach raw mode and detach key
stories.description: As a user, I want interactive attach with raw-mode input and tmux-like detach semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Attach enters raw mode, streams output, forwards keystrokes as `input`
Detach key sequence is `Ctrl-b` then `d` within 1s (configurable), and restores TTY
Handle SIGWINCH to send resize events automatically
Example: attach, type commands, then detach and return to shell prompt without corruption
Negative: `--read-only` prevents input from being sent to the session

stories.title: Observability + vibe-ctl debug
stories.description: As an operator, I want basic logs and metrics to diagnose terminald behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Add structured logs for session lifecycle events (start/stop/exit/error)
Expose metrics counters (active_sessions, active_connections, dropped_chunks_total, ws_backpressure_events_total)
Implement `vibe-ctl debug` to print server_info and current metrics
Example: `vibe-ctl debug` prints server version and active session count
Negative: debug without auth returns `auth_required`

stories.title: terminal_core unit tests
stories.description: As a developer, I want unit tests to validate buffering, sequencing, UTF-8 handling, and resizing.
acceptanceCriteria: Add unit tests for buffer truncation, seq ordering, UTF-8 chunk reassembly, and resize behavior
Tests run in the desktop crate’s test suite
Example: writing > 512 KB triggers truncated=true and snapshot present in payload
Negative: malformed UTF-8 across chunks does not panic and produces replacement characters

stories.title: Integration tests for WS flows and backpressure
stories.description: As a developer, I want integration tests for start/attach/detach and backpressure behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Add integration tests covering start->attach->input->output echo, detach->reattach, and multi-attach
Add backpressure test that triggers snapshot or disconnect deterministically
Example: two clients attached to the same session both receive output
Negative: calling attach without session_id returns `missing_session`

stories.title: Documentation updates and manual test checklist
stories.description: As a user, I want accurate docs for discovery, CLI usage, and manual validation steps.
acceptanceCriteria: Update docs to include discovery file schema, env overrides, and CLI examples
Add manual test checklist for desktop agent restart and mobile compatibility
Example: docs show `vibe-ctl new -s build --cwd ~/repo --cols 140 --rows 40`
Negative: docs must explicitly state localhost-only binding by default
